creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen 2026-09-28: every thread of v2's muster-daemon (started by Launch Services as MusterSessions.app, Developer ID signed) sat at priority 20, which is exactly what taskpolicy -c utility gives; its pane threads ask for user-interactive. An ad-hoc bundle built here and started the same way stayed at 31 and 46 for 20 minutes, hidden and locked. Under a utility clamp, ./dev --latency's under-load rows measured a tail read p95 of 51 ms and an echo 62 ms slower than idle. Worth checking the next signed build's daemon with ps -M after an hour of use.
title: Why v2's signed daemon ran under a utility clamp
